commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task list management
commitResults.messageBody: Move task collection operations behind TaskList so Unicorn no longer manages ArrayList directly. Preserve command behavior and persistence rollback support, and add focused tests for TaskList operations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console user interface
commitResults.messageBody: Move command input and all console output from Unicorn into Ui. Keep the existing command flow and messages unchanged while preparing command objects to interact through a single user-interface abstraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize classes into packages
commitResults.messageBody: Group application, UI, storage, and task classes under the unicorn package hierarchy while retaining src/main/java as the source root. Update imports and test package declarations, and expose task details through getters so Storage no longer relies on cross-package field access.
